name: My Quiet Love
overview: Yu Jiafei, a freshman with dreams of becoming a screenwriter, begins college and unexpectedly reunites with Jiang Oudi, the campus heartthrob she has secretly admired for years. At the same time, Jiang Oudi realizes that Jiafei is the mysterious singer he has been searching for and invites her to join his band. Brought together by music, the two slowly grow closer as they navigate friendship, self-discovery, and the challenges of college life.
